_source.recorded: 2026-11-25, read-only, with kubectl get -o json --show-managed-fields, from a live cluster
_source.object: A Host created and edited through the Control UI (control-api's agent PUT: the node-fetch Update entry that owns the whole spec, and control-api's clerum.io/administrative-intent-* annotations), then changed with kubectl patch, whose Update entry owns f:spec.f:approval.
_source.signal: None. There is no last-applied-configuration annotation and no Apply entry. Both managedFields entries are Update entries, which never count, although one of them owns f:spec.f:approval.
_source.synthetic: Scrubbed for the public repository. Synthetic: metadata.name, metadata.namespace, metadata.creationTimestamp, metadata.resourceVersion, metadata.generation, both clerum.io/administrative-intent-* annotation values, the managedFields times (their order kept), and every spec value outside spec.approval (host, contextRef, model.provider, model.name, model.connectionRef). Removed: metadata.uid (stricter than a synthetic value). As read: spec.approval (enum and boolean values only), spec.channels (empty), the annotation keys, and the managedFields managers, operations, apiVersions, fieldsTypes and fieldsV1 paths.
